# UE staging qualification repairs — primary source review

Reviewer: Codex /root, delegated staging operator. This is a primary-agent review, not a new independent-agent or human security-team approval. Historical PR984 agent reports retain their original scopes; account usage limits prevented another separate-agent review.

Scope: PR986, branch fix/ue-auth-storage-callers-20261022, base441556737ffe0e36c6ec9bf6bd9c24bab5302559, reviewed source97ec03f51db1a33070f835a3108a705d153b455f. The genuine signed manifest binds all27 actual source/base blobs and this review. The owner remains anungis437; the actual connected PR author is anungisa. The trust key remains identical to the immutable base. No human label, owner identity or independent reviewer is synthesized.

Canonical auth correctly denies raw business-role access with SQL42501. Deadline contact resolution now requires an active, nondeleted membership in the grievance organization before an email-selected canonical lookup, and constrains the exact assigned user and active/unlocked profile. Missing membership never opens auth authority; gateway failure propagates. Member revocation binds the real actor, target, organization, operation and reason and uses native auth session authority. Reactivation requires both auth and business membership writes on one physical transaction and both RETURNING row counts; a missing second row rolls back the first write. Existing route administrator guards and independent fail-closed revocation steps remain.

The companion grants only SELECT(id,user_id,organization_id,status) and UPDATE(status,updated_at) to the nonlogin auth-system executor. It requires forced RLS, separate ownership, safe canonical role attributes, no business-role inheritance of auth authority, and no unexplained prior grants/policies. Exact target/org/system operation and nonempty actor/reason are required; writes require active status. Private contacts, retargeting, deletion and arbitrary states stay denied. Canonical auth bootstrap bytes remain unchanged; companion SQL SHA256 remains11e3d4609fa4c0d02a8267fcc949aab115efca816152ab554c98e08208abd0a5, identical to the actual original clone rollback rehearsal. Full platform migration0041 is neither applied nor stamped.

The deployment verifier now checks both companion policies against the exact PostgreSQL-deparsed role, command, schema/table, permissive mode, USING and WITH CHECK contract. Only whitespace is normalized. Canonical V2 or explicit --require-auth-member-projection requires both policies and rejects absence or extras. Thirty actual PGlite execution/catalog tests pass, including PUBLIC/foreign/extra roles, wrong schema/table/command, OR broadening, unrestricted checks, changed phase/operation and missing/extra policies. A threaded Node/V8 crash is retained separately and is not passing evidence; the separate-process30/30 rerun and subsequent complete source21 aggregate pass are genuine.

The four Windows failures now execute the real branch validator through process.execPath and the resolved TSX CLI, and scan the same five source roots through Node with unchanged exclusions and assertions. Launch/filesystem errors fail closed. The scheduler/resolver continuity integration now mocks separate business membership and auth boundaries and verifies both successor selectors while retaining cancellation, recipient hash, grievor and audit assertions.

DOMPurify's reviewed override floor is>=3.4.17; every lockfile edge resolves3.4.17 with verified published integrity. Incidental tinyglobby drift was excluded. The actual browser reproduces both blocking advisories on3.4.14 and passes all7 patched checks on3.4.17. The audit removes five DOMPurify findings and has zero unwaived high/critical findings, with two pre-existing waivers unchanged. No severity, waiver or audit behavior is weakened. Root package/lock coverage is permitted only together in exact PR986; actual-blob verification rejects every semantic root package edit except the two exact reviewed overrides. One hundred twenty-three verifier tests pass, including actual API rejection of unrelated TOML lock changes.

Real service-plus-adapter composition exposed three missed retry failures: the canonical email service caught429/503/transport errors, then the adapter treated the resolved failure as permanent. The repair preserves optional statusCode/code through the existing service result and uses one adapter classifier for returned and thrown failures. Known HTTP status is authoritative: only the eight existing retryable statuses retry;400/401/403 remain permanent even with timeout wording. Without HTTP status, known transport codes/timeouts retry. Internal retry count/backoff and worker transaction/lease logic are unchanged. Fifty-two affected tests pass, including18 composition cases. Success still requires a provider message ID; unconfigured delivery stays disabled. These mock only the provider SDK and are not real mail delivery proof.

The remote Trivy scan on evidence commit c4ebcfab075cda010c1ef0d88b788fb2f1195269 found CVE-2026-114139 in Sentry10.47.0 and three TOML4.2.0 advisories(CVE-2026-114141/114143/114144). Scanner severity is retained; the Sentry maintainer rates its advisory moderate and describes conditional webpack tunnel middleware exposure. No severity is downgraded in repository policy. The exact Sentry override10.75.2 now covers all three existing consumers and its resolved SDK dependency closure. No application auth guards or middleware configuration are relaxed. The ignored local tooling directory had a tracked orphan npm lockfile; an explicit private manifest now preserves the same plugin7.2.52 with only the exact TOML5.0.1 override and Node>=20. The npm-generated lock changes only root manifest metadata and the published TOML version/URL/integrity, enforced against actual GitHub blobs. Both frozen installations pass. Actual vendor configuration/parser compatibility passes six checks. Existing Trivy0.70.0 with the unchanged ignore file reports zero high/critical findings across both repaired lockfiles. A fresh same-feed audit of the previous source proves no newly introduced advisory IDs, three critical findings removed and six fewer moderate findings; two pre-existing high waivers remain unchanged. No new waiver or scanner exclusion was added.

The source26 full typecheck exposed TS2307 in otel-core: its existing dynamic import of @fastify/otel relied on the old Sentry transitive hoist. The exact previously installed version0.18.0 is now declared as a direct optional dependency of its actual consumer. The lock delta adds only that importer and the two required package/snapshot records; incidental resolver changes to other application peers were excluded and the scoped frozen installation passes. The gate compares the actual OTel source/base manifest and allows only this exact optional declaration, rejecting script changes, version/range changes and other dependencies. Source26 lint passed, its typecheck failed, and its remaining fast test process was interrupted; those logs are retained and are not terminal PASS evidence. The new complete-source checks below are required.

All five mandatory checks pass on this exact frozen source: lint, typecheck, full fast tests(30975 passed), validate:docs and governance:audit. Their original logs and source-bound receipts are retained and hashed. The earlier source21 full aggregate(30957 passed) and all five checks are preserved distinctly; earlier interrupted aggregates are not terminal passes.

This reviewed source also passed1741/1741 actual PostgreSQL15 clone RLS checks through dedicated non-BYPASS principals. Strict forged writes in both directions returned42501; foreign reads/updates/deletes and empty context returned0; exact owned fixtures were removed. Fresh census preserves36 ledger rows,93 Django migrations and16 safe canonical auth roles. Retained original SQL/native transaction proofs are source-bound through unchanged bytes, not silently relabeled as a new image execution.

No unresolved P0/P1 was identified within this repair. Other legacy callers remain explicitly recorded and are not claimed repaired. Exact-head protected CI and four receipt-backed E2E shards plus aggregate remain mandatory before normal merge. Final integrated images, fresh image-bound signed clone qualification, governed live DDL,0% candidate, actual Entra/session/offboarding, controlled worker delivery/recovery, functional/audit/FR-EN/nav/telemetry acceptance and normal-host cutover are still required. No universal exactly-once delivery or historical application acceptance is asserted. Staging remains NO_GO; production authorization remains NO.
